Provide hands-on analysis, design, testing, implementation and post-implementation support. Implement security for Oracle Analytics Cloud. Collaborate with business users to gather and document business requirements for reporting and analytic requests. Act as a liaison between the business and technical teams to effectively communicate date reporting and requirements. Document and manage technical specifications. Manage on-time changes delivery and business expectations and ensure client satisfaction. Leading problem analysis, solutions development, implementation, and decision-making for Oracle Analytics Cloud. Validate configuration and data for Oracle Analytics Cloud. Define the Environment Strategy for Oracle Analytics Cloud. Complete development tasks based on requirements submitted by business partners and best practices.
cond_0641.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field is required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Ability to travel as needed to client sites or team meetings (approx. 10%, And this percentage may increase based on the need).
Minimum 8 years of demonstrated expertise in lead implementation in the Higher Education field (i.e., working on an implementation for a College or University, and this is not related to your personal education).
Minimum 8 years of proven client-facing experience and oversight.
Proven ability to work independently and within a team environment.

cond_0648.intro: We are looking for an Oracle Analytics Cloud Technical Developer to join our team.
